topic: Adjusting Belgian factor and data sources
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adjusting the advertising factor for Belgium, specifically relating to the 'City=19' category. Initially, [p1] requested that the factor be tied to categories in HQ and applied to Belgium. It was noted that factors are currently only set by partner, company, master-facility, or facility, not by category.

After discussion, it was determined that due to input from 'Esben', no changes should be made to the production environment for the factor at this time. [me] confirmed setting the factor of 19 on staging and being able to recalculate aggregates (e.g., for "Fix for Citymedia").

A separate technical discussion occurred regarding data availability, confirming that dwell-time is available in aggregates (`device_session_agg_4`) and can be retrieved by facility and hour.
decisions: No changes should be made to the production factor setting for Belgium (City=19) due to stakeholder input.
action_items: Review data source for dwell-time: `device_session_agg_4` by facility and hour.
